selectionGuide.description: A man sits behind a table whose sign serves as the focal space for a debatable claim or provocative thesis.
bestFor: a concise hot take presented as an invitation to debate
challenging a familiar convention with one assertive claim
framing a subjective opinion with deliberate confidence
avoidWhen: the point needs a long explanation or several qualifications
multiple actors or alternatives must be labeled separately
the joke requires a visual reaction or narrative reversal

mechanics.visual: The seated debater and prominently displayed sign frame the caption as a public challenge awaiting rebuttal.
mechanics.text: Write one compact, self-contained statement in sign; it should read as the thesis itself, not as a setup followed by a punchline.

slots.name: sign
slots.hint: the controversial opinion on the sign
